pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Tree View with a flat DOM: every visible node is a treeitem directly inside the tree and carries aria-level, aria-posinset, and aria-setsize (only part of the tree is rendered). Roving tabindex keeps one tab stop; the focused node always stays rendered.

aria.value: depth (1-based), position among visible siblings, and their count
true or false on parents (absent on leaves)
true or false when selection is not none
true, false, or mixed with checkboxes

keyboard.action: Focus the active node (one tab stop).
Collapsed parent: expand (loading lazy children). Expanded parent: first child. Failed load: retry.
Expanded parent: collapse. Otherwise: focus the parent.
Expand all siblings of the focused node.
Type-ahead to the next visible node whose label starts with the typed characters.
Activate (aui-activate); selects in single mode; retries a failed load.
Toggle the checkbox (checkboxes), toggle selection (multiple), or select (single).
Extend the selection from the anchor.
Select all visible nodes, or clear when all are selected.
Rename in a text input: Enter saves, Escape cancels.
Move the cut node inside the focused node (last child) or after it.
Move the focused node one place among its siblings.

focus: One tab stop (roving tabindex). The focused node stays rendered while scrolling; collapsing an ancestor or filtering it out moves focus to the nearest visible ancestor. After a move or rename, focus stays on the node.
notes: Dragging has a keyboard and single-pointer alternative (cut and paste, Alt+Arrow), meeting WCAG 2.5.7.
Loading, load failures, moves, renames, and filter results are announced politely (failures assertively) through the shared live region (WCAG 4.1.3).
Selection is shown by a start-edge bar as well as color; checked and mixed states by a check mark and a dash (WCAG 1.4.1).
knownCaveats: The tree is flat in the DOM (aria-level instead of nested groups) so it can be virtualized; screen readers announce levels from aria-level.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
